about.desc: Full Stack developer with experience building professional software. I move fast and solve complex technical problems — from architecture to deployment, no middlemen.

exp.title: Experience.
exp.r1Context: Software factory for the pharmaceutical industry
exp.r1Core: Responsible for the evolution, maintenance, and development of enterprise applications used by pharmaceutical companies. I build new features, optimize existing processes, and meet specific requirements on production systems where stability and operational continuity are critical. I contribute to technical decisions, architecture improvements, and solutions geared toward scalability, maintainability, and software quality.
exp.r3Title: Team Lead · Senior Full Stack Developer
exp.leadCore: I led a development team, combining technical leadership with hands-on development. I coordinated planning and delivery, helped define the architecture and scalable solutions, and established development best practices and code review. I was the go-to person for technical matters and the point of contact for international development teams, turning business needs into concrete solutions while actively building and evolving the platforms.
exp.r4Core: End-to-end development and maintenance of an e-commerce platform — backend, frontend, and infrastructure. I implemented features, optimized existing processes, and worked on the integration and deployment of applications on AWS.
exp.r5Core: Level 2 support on systems critical to logistics and shipping operations: incident analysis and resolution, monitoring of production processes, and automation of operational tasks with Bash and Rundeck, across Linux and Windows environments.

proj.title: Things I built to solve real problems.
proj.lede: Projects that show how I apply my stack to real challenges.
proj.p2Desc: Platform to organize birthdays remotely — invitations, RSVP, messages, and a shared gallery. Built on Firebase for auth and real-time data.

proj.p4Desc: Platform to manage income and expenses — simple and fast. Following the 50/30/20 model, it lets you categorize expenses, generate reports, and export data to Excel.
proj.p5Desc: Tools to automate user setup and management in AWS SSO environments, tunnels, etc.
proj.p6Desc: Command-line tool to simplify migrating data between systems.

srv.title: What I can do for your team.
srv.lede: I work both on fixed-scope projects and longer contracts. What matters is that the problem gets solved and the code stays maintainable.
srv.s1Desc: End-to-end web applications — frontend, backend, deploy. React, TypeScript, .NET, Laravel. From zero to production.
srv.s2Desc: Connecting systems — CRMs, payment gateways, ERPs, external services. Clean, documented, and testable design.
srv.s2d1: Design and implementation of REST APIs
srv.s3Desc: Team lead for 3 to 8 people. Code reviews, planning, standards, 1:1 mentoring.
srv.s4Desc: Migrating old stacks to modern ones. Incremental refactor, tests, zero-downtime deploys. PHP, .NET Framework, jQuery to TypeScript.

proc.title: A simple process, no surprises.
proc.lede: Four steps. The same ones I apply on every project.
proc.p1Desc: I unpack the business problem, map technical constraints, and define measurable success.
proc.p2Desc: Concrete proposal: scope, stack, deliverables, timeline. No ambiguity.
proc.p3Desc: Short deliveries, weekly demos, code in repos from day one.
proc.p4Desc: Brief documentation, reproducible deploy, post-delivery support window.
